name: Polish citizenship -- administrative recognition and Presidential grant (uznanie za obywatela polskiego / nadanie obywatelstwa przez Prezydenta RP)

requirement_groups.name: Recognition as a Polish citizen (settled applicants, integration-tested)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires continuous legal residence on permanent residence, EU long-term resident status, or the EU right of permanent residence, for a period set by which sub-track applies: 3 years for the general track (plus stable income and legal title to housing); 2 years if married 3+ years to a Polish citizen, stateless, or holding permanent residence due to refugee status; 1 year if permanent residence was obtained due to Polish origin or a held Pole's Card (see pl_karta_polaka); or 10 years for applicants who do not fit any faster track but have 10 years of continuous, legal residence plus stable income and housing.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain permanent residence or EU long-term resident status first (the fastest on-ramp is Karta Polaka), then continue accruing residence time on the applicable track.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires integration into Polish society, knowledge of Polish, a place to live, a source of income, respect for the Polish legal order, and not posing a threat to state defence or security.
requirements.fix_path: Complete a Polish-language exam and document stable housing and income.

requirement_groups.name: Grant by the President of Poland (fully discretionary, no fixed residence requirement)

requirements.blocker_text: Applicants must be legally resident in Poland under something more than a plain visa or visa-free stay (or apply via a consul from abroad); beyond that, the President of the Republic of Poland is bound by no statutory residence-length or integration criteria at all and grants citizenship at full personal discretion.

evidence_required.document: Confirmation of continuous legal residence at the applicable status and duration
Polish-language certificate or exam pass (administrative-recognition track only)
Full document set: civil-status records, ancestor documentation where relevant, biometric photo, valid travel document

sources.title: Powroty.gov.pl (official Polish government portal, gov.pl domain) -- Nabycie obywatelstwa polskiego
gov.pl / Łódzki Urząd Wojewódzki -- Uznanie za obywatela polskiego, reproducing Art. 30 of the Ustawa o obywatelstwie polskim (2 April 2009) in full
gov.pl / Pomorski Urząd Wojewódzki -- Uznanie za obywatela polskiego, independent reproduction of Art. 30 confirming the same tiered residence periods
Prezydent.pl (official website of the President of the Republic of Poland) -- Nadanie obywatelstwa polskiego

notes: Two genuinely different legal mechanisms, correctly modeled as separate OR-logic groups: administrative recognition (uznanie za obywatela polskiego) is a rules-based track with residence-length and integration criteria, decided by the voivode/minister; the Presidential grant (nadanie obywatelstwa) is a constitutional prerogative of the President of Poland alone, explicitly unbound by any statutory residence period, confirmed directly on prezydent.pl -- 'Prezydent RP nie jest związany żadnymi terminami w sprawach o nadanie obywatelstwa polskiego' (the President is not bound by any deadlines in citizenship-grant cases). Presidential decisions are also final and non-appealable ('postanowienia Prezydenta są niezaskarżalne'), a genuinely unusual feature not seen elsewhere in this dataset's settled-category routes, where administrative refusals are typically appealable. The stamp duty for a Presidential-grant application is a substantial PLN 1,669, confirmed via powroty.gov.pl, versus no equivalent flat fee structure on the administrative-recognition track. nat_residence's four-tier structure (3yr/2yr/1yr/10yr) is Art. 30(1) of the Ustawa o obywatelstwie polskim in full, cross-confirmed independently across the Łódzki and Pomorski voivodeship offices' gov.pl pages, which reproduce the statute's numbered subpoints verbatim and match each other exactly -- this replaces an earlier draft of this route that used a single vague '3 years, shorter for some categories' simplification; that simplification has now been resolved against the primary statutory tiers rather than left approximate. The 1-year Karta Polaka/Polish-origin track is the fastest of the four and is the same figure now used on pl_karta_polaka's citizenship_after_months (12, chained with that route's 0-month PR wait). This route is the terminal node for essentially every other Poland route's switchable_to/leads_to_citizenship chain (single_permit, eu_blue_card, business_activity, family_reunification, karta_polaka, permanent_residence, eu_long_term_resident all point here), matching this dataset's Journey-view design intent of deriving citizenship pathways from the underlying route graph rather than hand-authoring them.
